prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create one photorealistic premium studio product photograph of a single Happy Spoon COCOA LOCO 32 oz protein yogurt tub, faithfully translating the attached flat concept artwork into a real manufactured package. Input image is the design reference for the packaging, NOT the output layout. Only render the COCOA LOCO tub, not the other flavors or the design board.
Square composition, centered full tub occupying about 80% of image height, upright on a seamless warm off-white studio surface. Camera slightly above label center so lid top is visible, approximately 85mm commercial product lens, front label centered and fully readable, gentle perspective, realistic soft contact shadow, softbox illumination, subtle material highlights. No props, hands, extra packages, floating text or board headings.
Physical construction: realistic 32 oz tapered injection-molded yogurt container, wide round snap-on lid with fine molded rim details, slightly satin printed wrap label with natural cylindrical curvature. Convincing food packaging photography, not flat illustration, not cartoon or glossy toy. The dripping sauce shapes are FLAT PRINTED label graphics, not actual liquid; lid is clean and dry.
Preserve reference artwork hierarchy and recognizable appearance. Chocolate brown body #6B3A22, whipped-cream lid and printed drip band #FFF1DC; cream flavor lettering, brown HAPPY SPOON wordmark. No flecks.
Exact front text, in this order: small spaced condensed uppercase "HAPPY SPOON" in the drip band; very large bold condensed Anton-style "COCOA LOCO" arranged on two lines (COCOA / LOCO); smaller bold uppercase "CHOCOLATE"; bottom left vermilion #FF4F2E starburst with dark text "20g" over "PROTEIN"; bottom right slightly tilted near-black tape with white "0g ADDED SUGAR", beneath it "PROTEIN YOGURT", beneath it "NET WT 32 OZ (2 LB) 907g". Typography should closely match the supplied reference, correct spelling, crisp print, no new claims or added symbols.
Retain the approved colors, flavor names, drips, and layout. This is a faithful realistic mockup, not a redesign.
